trans-unit.source: The image compression saved you about %s of your file size!
Image is already optimally compressed, original was kept.
API key: Please insert your Tinyfy API key
Enable or disable debugging mode. Stops extension from compressing images. Use in development mode to avoid wasting compressions.
Comma-separated list of folders which should be excluded from compression. Relative from storage (e.g. fileadmin), starting with "/" (e.g. "/user_upload,/folder_under_fileadmin")
Comma-separated list of supported image mime types.
Show image compression limit within the system information toolbar.
Show compression status in file metadata form.
Show compression statistics in the system reports module.
Backup original files: Keep a copy of the original file before compression, so it can be restored later.
Backup retention (days): Backups older than this are removed by the "imagecompression:pruneBackups" command. 0 keeps backups indefinitely.
Restoring the original file failed. No valid backup was found.
Preserve copyright metadata: Keep the EXIF/IPTC copyright tag instead of stripping it during compression.
Preserve creation date metadata: Keep the EXIF/IPTC creation date instead of stripping it during compression.
Preserve color profile: Keep the embedded ICC color profile instead of stripping it during compression.

Compression Provider(s): tinify = TinyPNG API, local-tools = jpegoptim/optipng/etc., local-basic = ImageMagick/GraphicsMagick. Comma-separated for a fallback order, e.g. "tinify,local-tools" falls back to local-tools once tinify's quota is exhausted or for a MIME type tinify does not support.
JPEG Quality (1-100): Quality setting for local JPEG compression
PNG Quality (1-100): Quality setting for local PNG compression (pngquant)
WebP Quality (1-100): Quality setting for local WebP compression
Command Timeout (seconds): Timeout for external tool invocations (local-tools/local-basic providers)
Minimum saving (%, 0-100): Compressed result must be at least this much smaller than the original to be kept. Below this, the original file is preserved.
The compression provider currently in use.
Some images could not be compressed. Check the file list for details.
TinyPNG API compression count for this month. View Dashboard
Total disk space saved across all successfully compressed files.
Reset structured image compression columns for legacy compressed files

Earlier versions of this extension stored the compression result as a single formatted string (compress_info). That column has been replaced with structured columns (provider, tool, original size, compressed size, timestamp). Re-parsing the legacy strings is not attempted; this wizard resets the new columns to "unknown" for files that are already marked as compressed, leaving the compressed flag itself untouched.
